label: Mandopop / Pop Rock with Electronic elements

cards.mood: The piece opens with a mysterious and contemplative atmosphere, establishing a sense of vastness and solitude.
cards.palette: A bright, resonant piano serves as the harmonic backbone, playing arpeggiated figures in the verses and shifting to block chords in the choruses to drive the progression.

cards.mood: The track launches immediately with high-energy optimism and youthful exuberance, maintaining a driving momentum through the verses.
cards.palette: Distorted electric guitars provide the core harmonic drive with power-chord riffs and melodic lead lines, present from the intro through to the outro.
